sense: for a phone or a battery

terms.grammar: phrase: the dative of purpose with a gerundive
terms.comment: Our formation, and a provisional one: no reference work has a word. In talk, īnstrūmentum alone will usually do once the thing is in view.

sources: Lewis & Short: instrumentum · Lewis & Short: repleo
No source has a Latin word for a charger; the phrase is built on our word for charging (see “charge”).
